```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}

```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
```
```{r}
ggplot(weather)
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
))
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line()
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp (C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```
